meta.title: All Vendors: The Invite button behavior is shown when vendor addition is locked

plan.title: Draft Invite Behavior When Vendor Addition Is Locked

steps.note: Reach the Events list before opening the saved draft.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully.
Open the first saved draft; drafts reopen on the create screen.
Confirm the draft exposes the Participants control.
Open the draft's participant and All Vendors interface.
Confirm the All Vendors window is open.
Verify the Invite action is rendered before exercising it.
Exercise the Invite behavior while vendor addition is locked.
Record the opened window, available actions, disabled state, fields, and any message produced by the locked Invite flow.

args.label: Search vendors you want to add

steps.note: Search for the required QA test vendor when the search field is available.
Record whether the searched vendor can be selected or added and whether the controls are enabled or disabled.
Confirm the requested QA vendor search text or matching result is visible.
Close the All Vendors window without changing the draft.
Confirm the flow returned to the draft screen after cancellation.
